title: Quote stack
description: Pair with BOD-07 or after a feature run. Exactly three quotes, each under 25 words.
usage: Three short peer quotes in bordered cards under one heading. Locked layout — edit only text.
notes: The #7B8290 card border (border/primary) is unchanged in dark mode.
Heading uses mfs-h2 per CONVENTIONS (28 → 24 on mobile); the Figma Mobile frame keeps 28px.
Padding drops from 48px to 32px, card gaps from 24px to 16px and card padding from 16/24 to 8/16 on mobile.
